newsitem.title: Italy: Port conditions update - Italy/Algeria - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Italy/Algeria - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ITALY, Dec 2 - Messina - The port of Gioia Tauro has been closed because of bad weather on November 30, December 1 and December 2. No other ports in the area have been closed because of bad weather, though it is understood that vessels have encountered difficulty in manoeuvring in Milazzo.
ALGERIA, Dec 3 - Algiers - During the last two weeks, 10 to 12 vessels reported at anchorage awaiting berths. Average time in roads 2 or 3 days.
